 * Building relationships with our restaurant and retail partners by training them on using our systems and keeping them up to speed on any updates

 * Ensuring our portfolio of restaurants and retail shops reach the highest Wolt service standards by conducting frequent quality and satisfaction checks

 * Managing equipment inventory
